name: logindesk
description: Log in to websites without the agent ever seeing a secret.
long_description: A local broker fills passwords and emailed one-time codes into its own sealed browser and returns only a status. Needs a running `logindesk daemon` (start it in a terminal with the same binary).

tools.name: login
tools.description: Log in to a site with a stored account; returns a status and session_id.

tools.name: signup
tools.description: Create an account with the user's identity and a generated password, verified by email.

tools.name: wait
tools.description: Wait for a login or signup that is waiting on the user's approval.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: Stored accounts: id, site and username only.

tools.name: open
tools.description: Open a page in the sealed browser to fill it step by step.

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: Masked view of the page with field kinds; field values are never shown.

tools.name: type
tools.description: Type non-secret text (name, phone, dropdowns). Password and code fields are refused.

tools.name: fill_secret
tools.description: The broker fills a password, new password, sign-up email or emailed code into a field; the value is never returned.

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Open a URL on the session's own site.

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click an element by its snapshot ref.
